name: Dev (mise, Claude Code, GitHub CLI)
description: Thin template on a prebuilt image with mise (Node.js and other runtimes), the Claude Code CLI and the GitHub CLI. Logins, settings, tool installs and shell history persist across rebuilds in named volumes.

imageVariant.description: Prebuilt image tag: a major version (1) gets compatible updates only; also 1.2, 1.2.3, latest or a dated tag like 2026-11-07:

volumePrefix.description: Prefix for the shared volumes (Claude Code, GitHub CLI, mise). Containers using the same prefix share logins and tool installs:
